exposure: first trimester maternal biomarkers (PAPP-A, b-hCG, PlGF, sFlt-1)
cohort: The study participants were 296 singleton pregnancies in the Maastricht University Medical Centre between 2012 and 2016.
finding: Combining fetal growth velocity with first trimester maternal biomarkers significantly improved the prediction of small-for-gestational age (SGA) and adverse neonatal outcomes compared to baseline screening alone.
birth_weight: Defined as birth weight percentile <10 for SGA and 10-90 for AGA.
gest_age: Measurements taken at 11-13, 18-22, and 30-34 weeks GA; SGA defined based on gestational age.
